name: Claude Desktop

ui_steps: Enter the name {name} and the URL {url}, then continue
Review detected authentication settings; choose sign-in mode (Sign in now / Sign in when needed / No sign in)
Under OAuth client choose Register automatically, Claude's published identity, or your own client
Optionally add fixed credentials under Request headers
Remote connectors are configured via the Claude account; claude_desktop_config.json is for local servers (separate mechanism)

plan_limits: Custom connectors on Free (limit 1), Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, Enterprise. Team: Owner/Primary Owner adds under Organization settings > Connectors, then members click Connect. Enterprise: Owners, Primary Owners, custom role with Manage access to Libraries.

verification.gaps: Article does not name transports; connection originates from Anthropic cloud so server must be publicly reachable. 'Register automatically' presumed = DCR but article does not use that term. claude_desktop_config.json path, instruction file, hooks not fetched. Team/Enterprise members share one header credential.
